subject: Invoice-matching dashboard spec & VAT ownership
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Petrova <anna@openocean.com>, PaymentOps <payments@openocean.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Invoice-matching dashboard spec & VAT ownership

Hi Anna / OpenOcean payments team —

Quick one to align inbound: as we move to an annual prepay with monthly drawdown reconciliation for DL-9832, our finance and ops teams want a lightweight dashboard that lets both sides reconcile invoice credits to drawdowns and capture VAT ownership per country. The goal is to reduce manual exceptions during monthly sweeps.

Attached is a first-pass spec (invoice-matching-dashboard-spec-v1.xlsx) and a sample ledger export. High-level asks:
- Single-row match view for each invoice line (invoice number, invoice date, credited amount, drawdown reference, remaining balance)
- VAT ownership column (country code + evidence ID) with link to uploaded VAT evidence
- Filters: date range, invoice status (open/partially matched/closed), country, payment method, and drawdown tranche
- Exportable CSV for our accounting team

Could you confirm:
1) who at OpenOcean will own VAT evidence uploads (PaymentOps or ProcureOps)?
2) is there an existing invoice reference field we should use to tie back to your AP system?
3) any monthly cutoff windows we need to respect in April/May for EU VAT reporting?

Ben and Lauren — looping you in so you see the initial ask. If you can review the spec and suggest any Redwood-specific columns we need to add for audits, that'd be great.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: invoice-matching-dashboard-spec-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), sample-ledger-export-2027Q1.csv (csv), vat-evidence-matrix.docx (docx)

From: Anna Petrova <anna@openocean.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: PaymentOps <payments@openocean.com>, ProcureOps <procure@openocean.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-11T13:05:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Invoice-matching dashboard spec & VAT ownership

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks for the spec. Quick answers inline:
1) VAT evidence will be owned by ProcureOps for supplier-side uploads; PaymentOps will own payment confirmations. We can grant Redwood a read-only link for evidence items.
2) Our AP system uses a 12-digit reference (APRef) we can include on outgoing invoices. We can also map your invoice_id to APRef on ingestion.
3) Monthly cutoff: our collections cut-off is the 25th EOB local time for the following-month remittance. Any matches after the 25th typically flow to the next month's accounting.

We'll drop an initial sample of APRef mappings by EOD tomorrow. Can your team consume APRef as a new matching column?

Best,
Anna
Finance Ops Manager
OpenOcean Systems

On Mon, Apr 12, 2027 at 17:05 +0200 Anna Petrova <anna@openocean.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the spec...

Quick notes from our side after scanning the sample ledger:
- We'll add fields for: Redwood invoice_id (ours), external APRef (their 12-digit), drawdown_tranche_id, matched_amount, match_confidence (low/medium/high)
- For VAT evidence we should capture two things: VAT_status (verified/pending) and VAT_doc_id (link to stored doc). That will make audits easier.
- Suggest we expose a small webhook (POST) to notify PaymentOps when a match falls below 90% confidence so they can review exceptions prior to the 25th cutoff.

Lauren — can you scope UX: a single table with an exceptions tab, and a quick export button for monthly remits? Once we have a UX doc we can push a short FRD to eng.

-ben
Ben Carter
Revenue Operations (Redwood)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-13T10:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice-matching dashboard spec & VAT ownership

Thanks Ben — noted. Draft UX notes attached. High-level:
- Landing: summary KPIs (open invoices, matched %, exceptions queue count, total outstanding by country)
- Table: sortable columns (invoice_id, APRef, invoice_date, amount, matched_amount, match_confidence, vat_status, vat_doc_id, drawdown_tranche_id, last_updated)
- Exceptions flow: side panel with quick resolve actions (assign owner, attach VAT doc, force-match, add comment)
- Export: checkbox to include 'evidence links' vs redact links for external consumption

I'll attach a brief wireframe (included) and can sync with Procurement/PaymentOps on Thursday if that works for Anna.

-lauren
Senior Product Manager, Finance UX
Redwood Inference

Hi Kimberly / team —

We reviewed the rows and confirm APRef will be populated on our invoices starting May 1. A couple operational points:
- For drawdown tranches: we publish a tranche id on the remittance advice (format TR-YYYYMM-<n>). Please accept both TR-YYYYMM and TR-YYYYMM-<n> formats in the matching logic.
- VAT evidence upload: ProcureOps will host the evidence in the vendor portal; we can surface read links to Redwood. Please provide a secure link pattern (S3 pre-signed or Drive link) and a retention TTL; our legal requires evidence be retained 7 years for EU operations.
- We'll coordinate a short weekly reconciliation call (15 min) in the first month to work out edge cases.

Thanks,
PaymentOps Team
OpenOcean Systems
